display.name: View counter: write load test
display.description: HTTP rate and latency, ingest backlog, writer and Postgres throughput, CPU and Go runtime during a load test.

display.name: Requests per second
display.description: Server requests per second by route (all requests, not sampled).

display.name: Request latency (/v2/hit)
display.description: p50, p95 and p99 server-side duration of POST /v2/hit.

display.name: Responses by status
display.description: Requests per second by status code.

display.name: Ingest backlog
display.description: pending: published, not yet fetched. ack_pending: fetched, not yet committed.

display.name: Writer throughput
display.description: Rows committed per second by Postgres (inserts on seen and page_views).

display.name: Writer transaction latency
display.description: p95 duration of Postgres client spans from the writer (sampled traces).

display.name: Pool contention
display.description: Acquires that had to wait for a free connection (per sec).

display.name: Container CPU
display.description: CPU utilization per container (NATS and Postgres). k6 and the service are on the host.

display.name: Host CPU
display.description: Host CPU by state. Near 100% busy means k6, service, NATS and Postgres compete.

display.name: Go allocation rate
display.description: Bytes allocated per second by the service. High values mean GC pressure.

display.name: Go heap, GC goal and goroutines
display.description: Heap in use, next GC target and goroutine count.

display.name: Container network
display.description: Bytes per second in and out of the NATS and Postgres containers.

display.name: Slowest spans
display.description: Server spans by route: count, p95 and max (sampled traces).
